title: Enacted — Montgomery County Water Quality & Resources Feed
description: Records what changed in enacted land-use law and public water quality. Does not advise, approve, determine, or certify anything.

items.title: Distribution System Customer Taps · Lead
items.summary: As reported by Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission (WSSC Water) for Distribution System Customer Taps: <2.0 µg/L. Governing requirement: 15 µg/L (EPA Lead and Copper Rule (Action Level); compliance date: In force (Action level lowers to 10 µg/L beginning November 1, 2027); basis: 90th percentile of customer tap samples).

items.title: Patuxent Water Filtration Plant Tap · Perfluorooctanoic acid (PFOA)
items.summary: As reported by Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission (WSSC Water) for Patuxent Water Filtration Plant Tap: 1.8 ng/L. Governing requirement: 4.0 ng/L (EPA National Primary Drinking Water Regulation (MCL); compliance date: Beginning April 26, 2029; basis: Running annual average of quarterly samples; status: Proposed extension to April 26, 2031 for eligible systems that apply for an exemption under SDWA §1416(f) (FR 2026-10086)).
